fullDescription: A high-fidelity dark-themed AI interface featuring a minimalist 'Cyber-Tech' aesthetic. It utilizes a deep black and charcoal palette (#0A0A0A, #0D0D0D) with vibrant indigo accents (#6366F1). Key features include glassmorphism-lite elements, bento-style sidebar configuration, and high-performance typography using Plus Jakarta Sans for UI and JetBrains Mono for technical data. Ideal for SaaS dashboards, AI chat platforms, developer tools, and fintech applications requiring a sophisticated, professional dark mode.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated AI chat interface built on a deep dark palette with modular sidebar controls, a centered chat stream, and a glow-enhanced floating input bar.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a deep dark background (#0A0A0A). Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (Weights: 400, 500, 600, 700) for all primary UI elements and 'JetBrains Mono' for technical labels. 

Colors:
- Primary Background: #0A0A0A
- Secondary Background (Sidebar/Header): #0D0D0D
- Component Background (Inputs/Cards): #161616
- Accent Color: Indigo-500 (#6366F1)
- Border Color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) or rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)
- Text: Main text at #E5E7EB, secondary at rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)

Interactive States:
- Hover: Smooth transition-colors (150ms-200ms).
- Focus: Inputs should use a subtle Indigo glow or border-color shift.
- Scrollbars: Custom thin width (4px) with #262626 thumb and #404040 hover state.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Height: 64px (h-16). Background: #0D0D0D. Border-bottom: 1px solid white/5. Layout: Flex-row with items-center. Left side: 32px square logo container (bg-white/10) with an icon, followed by a brand name and a version badge in JetBrains Mono (text-white/40, 12px). Right side: Settings trigger icon with 24px padding.

### Sidebar
Width: 256px (w-64). Background: #0D0D0D. Border-right: 1px solid white/5. Padding: 16px (p-4). Content: Section labels in uppercase (10px, bold, tracking-widest, text-white/30). Form elements: Dropdowns (select) with #161616 background, rounded-lg (8px), and custom chevron icons. Spacing between sections: 24px.

### Chat Stream
Centered container max-width: 48rem (max-w-3xl). Spacing: 48px between messages (space-y-12). User Message: Aligned right, text-lg, text-white/80. Bot Message: Flex layout with an 8px square icon (bg-indigo-500/20) on the left and text-lg leading-relaxed on the right. Highlight keywords using <b> tags.

### Floating Input Bar
Fixed at bottom-center. Padding: 24px (p-6). Max-width: 3xl. Background: #161616 with a 1px border white/10. Shape: 16px rounded (rounded-2xl). Feature: A background 'glow' effect using an absolute inset-0.5 div with a linear-gradient (indigo to purple) at 10% opacity, increasing to 25% on focus. Elements: Multiline textarea with transparent background, white/20 placeholder, and a primary action button (white bg, black icon) in the bottom-right corner.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### API Settings Modal — A centered overlay for sensitive configuration.
Overlay: Full-screen black/70 backdrop with backdrop-blur-sm. Card: Max-width 28rem (max-w-md), background #0D0D0D, border white/10. Header: Flex-row with 'API Configuration' title and close icon. Body: Vertical stack of password-type inputs with 10px uppercase labels. Footer: Two-button row—'Cancel' (transparent/border) and 'Save' (Indigo-600 bg with shadow-indigo-600/20).

### Glow Input Container — Input field with an interactive outer glow.
Wrap the input container in a div. Add a child div with `absolute -inset-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 rounded-2xl blur opacity-10`. On parent focus-within, transition the child opacity to 25% over 500ms.

style.description: The style is 'Technical Minimalist'. It relies on hierarchy through opacity rather than color variations, using white at 30%, 40%, 60%, and 80% opacities against a pure black or deep charcoal background. Typography pairs the humanist 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for readability with the technical 'JetBrains Mono' for versioning and metadata. Borders are thin (1px) and subtle (white/5 or white/10), creating a clean, structured look without heavy shadows.
